name: agent-browser
summary: Browser automation CLI for AI agents: a native Rust binary that drives Chrome with snapshots, sessions and WebMCP.
description: A Rust CLI that lets agents drive Chrome: element snapshots and semantic locators, click/fill/wait/batch commands, annotated screenshots, tabs, frames, dialogs, cookies and network tools, plus persistent Chrome profiles. Ships WebMCP support (experimental), React DevTools introspection and Web Vitals commands, and an embedded axe-core accessibility audit that runs offline. Installs via npm, Homebrew or Cargo; docs at agent-browser.dev.
contains: native Rust CLI; install via npm, Homebrew, Cargo or source
snapshots with element refs plus semantic and CSS locators
WebMCP support (experimental) with bounded tool summaries
React introspection and Web Vitals commands; --human mouse movement
axe-core accessibility audits embedded in the binary, offline and CSP-safe
sessions, tab labels, persistent Chrome profiles, batch execution
